profile.headline: Software Engineer at Edwards LifeSciences, Simple Software Solutions LLC
profile.summary:
Title:
Embedded Software Engineer.

Occupation:
Software Engineer at Edwards Lifesciences.

Interests:
Passionate about C/C++ software development in Embedded systems and Windows/Linux environments.

Aspiring to integrate my passion and skillset in C++ to robotics engineering and mechatronics.

Growing interests in other development languages and disciplines such as C# for Unity game development and Virtual/Augmented Reality development.

Dabbled in Computer Vision with Python OpenCV.

Field of Study:
Bachelors in Electonics Engineering, spec in renewable energy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In-house contractor, take on variety of department challenges, beginning from test tool development, to embedded feature development, to CI/CD infrastructure development and automated testing infrastructure.
Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain and test C++ code.
Develop and maintain Python scripts.
Help to maintain and improve on tool chains.
Perform software unit tests.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
In-house contractor, take on variety of department challenges, beginning from test tool development, to embedded feature development, to CI/CD infrastructure development and automated testing infrastructure.

Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain and test C++ code.
Develop and maintain Python scripts.
Help to maintain and improve on tool chains.
Perform software unit tests.

Task:
Integrated Python Azure CLI tools and GIT tools into existing documentation scripts for SVN, as a solution to retrieve Pull Request, Code Review, and Diff information from Azure for Edwards Standard documentation of Software Release Packages.

Task:
Developed proof-of-concept prototype client application in C++ (Qt) to aid product developers and testers. Tool Listens to Server and Client communications and displays product data.

Task:
Developed device drivers and API for i2c and I/O Data clocking for Integrated Chip FTDI Command Processor called Multi-Protocol Synchronous Serial Engine (MPSSE). 

Task:
Updated existing test application hardware interface for new test tool hardware.

Task:
Developed robust automated testing framework in Python 3 and hundreds of complementing tests using gRPC protocol buffers for build verification testing and backward compatibility testing of product firmware on-target from Azure CI/CD pipelines.

Task:
Port embedded source code from a project predecessor to project successor on a module-by-module basis. Port from STM32F4 series to STM32F7 series. Update code to conform to new communication protocol. Leverage STM32 HAL Drivers for i2c comms between authentication IC's and Display LED IC.
Bring up existing features such as Power Manager Sub-System, Alarm Sub-Systems, Diagnostics Sub-System.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer @ Edwards LifeSciences
positions.description:
Developed Sensor Simulator Application driving custom hardware developed in-house.

Task:
Developed C++ API for FTDI's FT201XB.
Developed C++ API for Sensor Simulator Feature Requirements.
Developed Graphical User Interface (Py Qt) which interfaces with Sensor Simulator API.

Details:
Application communicates as i2c Slave to an i2c Master subsystem running on STM32 Product.
Application functions as a real-time application, which sends live data input by user to Master Device.
Simulated Data is input by User using GUI, or by reading a pre-populated file.
Data conversion from ml/hr to raw hexadecimal, and back available using Sensor Data Sheet Formulas.

positions.title: shipping/recieving
positions.locationName: Santa Fe Springs, California, United States
positions.description:
Prepare orders for shipment, interact with customers for will-call, manage warehouse inventory, keep warehouse clean and tidy, collaborate with customer service uphold customer satisfaction, collaborate with purchasing to maintain stocked inventory.

Warehouse keeper and inventory specialist.

positions.title: Welder
positions.description:
Welding school SMAW and Metal Inert Gas; 1F, 2F, 3F, 1G,2G, 3G.
Acquired certifications, 3F SMAW and 3G MIG.

Manufacture emergency response vehicles, bicycle and tricycle ambulance.
Use welding fundamentals to build robust vehicles for rough terrain.

volunteerExperiences.role: Translation of safety protocol and use of devices
Informing the public in an event about earthquake awareness
volunteerExperiences.description: I have some volunteer experience with the Red Cross where I participated in events that informed the public in large city wide events about the necessity of earthquake awareness and preparation. I informed people about the necessities of an earthquake preparedness kit and the various resources that one should accumulate to react safely after a disaster. These events were held in multilingual environments, mostly English and Spanish.
